about.title: Who we are
about.lead: A Central African firm of audit, accounting expertise and professional training.
about.paragraph1: Founded by Marie-Claire Ngbokoli, COSI Lewa-Consulting Group is a consulting, audit and training firm based in Bangui, Central African Republic. Since its creation, the firm's mission has been to support businesses, non-governmental organizations and public institutions in mastering their accounting, tax and social obligations.
about.paragraph2: Our team is made up of seasoned professionals, chartered accountants, auditors and trainers who put their experience at the service of your performance. We operate in all sectors of activity, from trade to humanitarian work, including microfinance and public services.
about.paragraph3: Beyond technical expertise, we build close and trusting relationships with each of our clients. We believe in a Central Africa where every organization has access to quality accounting and tax services to grow and innovate.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.lead: Reveal talents, secure finances, build the future.
mission.item1Desc: Provide businesses and NGOs with reliable accounting and tax expertise to secure their financial management and regulatory compliance.
mission.item2Desc: Be the trusted partner of Central African economic players, advising, auditing and training them with rigor and dedication.
mission.item3Desc: Prepare students and professionals for careers in accounting, finance and management through practical, certified training programs.
mission.item4Desc: Contribute to the economic development of Central Africa by promoting accounting and financial excellence as a growth lever.

services.faqQ1: What does an audit mission involve?
services.faqR1: An audit mission involves examining an organization's accounts and internal processes to ensure their reliability, compliance and effectiveness. We provide a detailed report with our recommendations.
services.faqQ2: What are the tax obligations for an NGO in CAR?
services.faqR2: NGOs in CAR must maintain accounts in accordance with the SYCEBNL framework, file tax (VAT, IRPP) and social (CNSS) declarations. We support organizations in all these procedures.
services.faqQ3: Do you offer one-off or regular support?
services.faqR3: Both options are available. We offer one-off assignments (audit, account review) as well as regular support (monthly bookkeeping, periodic declarations).
services.faqQ4: How long does an audit mission take?
services.faqR4: The duration of an audit mission depends on the size of the organization and the complexity of its operations. On average, an audit mission lasts between one and three weeks.

expertise-comptable.title: Accounting expertise
expertise-comptable.short: Tailored support close to your challenges
expertise-comptable.desc: As an accounting firm, we provide tailored advice to guarantee reliable financial management, compliant and perfectly adapted to your organization's needs.
expertise-comptable.points:
General and analytical bookkeeping
Tax filings (VAT, payroll tax) and social declarations (CNSS)
Supporting NGOs with the SYCEBNL accounting framework
Year-end account review and reliability
Tax optimization advice
expertise-comptable.details:
Our firm provides you with a team of experienced chartered accountants to handle your entire accounting. We work with companies, non-governmental organizations and public institutions alike.
We use modern accounting tools to guarantee the reliability and traceability of your financial data. Each engagement includes personalized follow-up with regular reporting.
For NGOs, we have full command of the SYCEBNL framework, mandatory in the Central African Republic, and support you in setting up and maintaining your accounts.
expertise-comptable.benefits:
Time savings on administrative and accounting management
Securing your tax and social obligations
Better decision-making through clear reporting
Compliance with accounting standards in force in CAR

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do I register for a training program?
faq.r1: You can register by phone at +236 72 69 67 00, by email at cabinetcosi29@gmail.com, or via our online contact form. An advisor will help you choose the module best suited to your level and goals.
faq.r2: Payment can be made in cash or in weekly installments. We offer flexible payment options to make our training accessible to as many people as possible. Contact us to discuss terms.
faq.r3: Yes, each training program concludes with the issuance of a certificate of participation and an attestation. We also assist you in drafting your professional CV to showcase your new skills.
faq.q4: Can I take a training course in the evening or on weekends?
faq.r4: Absolutely. Our sessions are flexible and adapt to your availability: weekdays, evenings or weekends. Simply indicate your preferred time slots when registering.
faq.q5: Are there any prerequisites for registering?
faq.r5: Most of our training programs are accessible without specific prerequisites. For advanced modules (such as Sage Compta or SYCEBNL), basic accounting knowledge is recommended. Our team will advise you on the most suitable path.
faq.q6: Where do the training sessions take place?
faq.r6: Training takes place at our headquarters: Avenue des Martyrs — SOCATEL, across from Stade 20 000 Places, Bangui. We can also organize on-site sessions for businesses and organizations.

session-comptabilite-bancaire-2026.title: Launch of the intensive bank accounting training session
session-comptabilite-bancaire-2026.excerpt: COSI Firm is opening registrations for its new bank accounting training session. 20 hours of practical modules to master account management, cash operations and customer relations in a banking environment.
session-comptabilite-bancaire-2026.content:
COSI Lewa-Consulting Group is pleased to announce the launch of its new intensive bank accounting training session, scheduled for July 2026.

This 20-hour training is designed for professionals and students wishing to acquire a solid mastery of bank account management, cash operations and customer relations in a banking environment.

Program:
- Techniques for managing current and savings accounts
- Managing cash and counter operations
- Processing cheques, transfers and direct debits
- Customer relations and banking advice
- Regulatory compliance and anti-money laundering

Registrations are open. The participation fee is 75,000 FCFA, payable in two installments. Each participant will receive a certificate of completion and a professional CV.

To register, contact us at +236 72 69 67 00 or by email at cabinetcosi29@gmail.com. Places are limited.

accompagnement-sycebnl-2026.title: SYCEBNL support: the firm now referenced by new NGOs
accompagnement-sycebnl-2026.excerpt: Two new non-governmental organizations have entrusted us with maintaining their accounts under the SYCEBNL framework. A recognition of our expertise in the non-profit sector in Central Africa.
accompagnement-sycebnl-2026.content:
COSI Lewa-Consulting Group is expanding its expertise in the non-profit sector. Two new international non-governmental organizations have recently entrusted us with maintaining their accounts under the SYCEBNL framework (Non-Profit Entities Accounting System).

This new collaboration reflects the recognition of our expertise in accounting and financial support for NGOs in the Central African Republic. Our team fully masters the specificities of SYCEBNL, a framework adapted to the particularities of non-profit organizations.

Our services include:
- Full bookkeeping under the SYCEBNL framework
- Preparation of annual financial statements
- Assistance with external audits
- Tax and social declarations
- Financial management advice and donor reporting

We also support NGOs in training their accounting teams on the SYCEBNL framework, ensuring progressive autonomy and better control of their management tools.

atelier-declaration-fiscale-tpe.title: Free workshop: tax filing basics for small businesses
atelier-declaration-fiscale-tpe.excerpt: As part of our commitment to local economic development, COSI Firm is organizing a free workshop on tax filings (VAT, IRPP, CNSS) for very small businesses in Bangui.
atelier-declaration-fiscale-tpe.content:
As part of our commitment to local economic development, COSI Lewa-Consulting Group is organizing a free workshop on tax filings for very small businesses (VSBs) in Bangui.

This practical workshop will cover the following topics:
- Value Added Tax (VAT) declaration
- Personal Income Tax (IRPP)
- National Social Security Fund (CNSS) contributions
- Common filing obligations for very small businesses
- Tax deadlines not to be missed

The workshop will take place at our premises: Avenue des Martyrs — SOCATEL, across from Stade 20 000 Places, Bangui. A Q&A session is planned at the end of the presentation.

Participation is free, but registration is required. Contact us at +236 72 69 67 00 to reserve your spot. Places are limited to 20 participants.

certificats-bureautique-2026.title: Certificate ceremony for the office IT session graduates
certificats-bureautique-2026.excerpt: 12 participants received their office IT training certificate. A committed cohort, ready for the job market.
certificats-bureautique-2026.content:
COSI Lewa-Consulting Group presented the end-of-training certificates to the 12 participants of the office IT session, concluding a four-week intensive training cycle.

During this training, participants acquired solid skills on essential professional software:
- Microsoft Word: layout, mail merge, long documents
- Microsoft Excel: spreadsheets, formulas, charts, pivot tables
- Microsoft PowerPoint: professional and animated presentations
- Microsoft Access: databases and queries

This 2026 cohort stands out for the diversity of its profiles: newly graduated students, professionals changing careers and administrative staff wishing to strengthen their skills.

Congratulations to all graduates! The next session is scheduled for September 2026. Registrations are already open.
